purpose: Acquire a true approximately 1 m post-spacing Mars DTM for 200-1000 m morphology; do not call a 20 m CTX grid a fine-terrain reference.
anchor_basis: Published HiRISE DTM product center coordinate, chosen before reading candidate windows or retrieval scores.
read_policy: Retrieve full contiguous source rows by HTTP Range in 500-row chunks, validate each Content-Range and length, then slice columns locally. This bounds network transfer to approximately 98 MB instead of downloading the 700 MB image or triggering thousands of small GDAL reads.
coverage_gate: At least 99.5% finite non-nodata pixels in the frozen crop before it can enter 200/500/1000 m comparisons.
limitations: A 1 m DTM post spacing is not a 1 m guarantee of resolved rocks or rover-scale hazards.
The PDS elevation is in metres above the Mars 2000 equipotential surface; cross-site morphology uses median-subtracted heights, never absolute Earth-Mars datum equality.
This Jezero site is a known scientific field area, not a new Mars analog discovery or independent heldout reference.
The paired orthophoto and surface composition remain separate acquisitions and interpretations.
